company.name: PayMongo
company.shortDescription: PayMongo is a financial operating system that enables businesses to accept payments, manage transactions, and borrow capital.
company.description:
PayMongo is a financial technology company building the financial operating system for the Philippines’ digital economy. It offers a powerful suite of tools that enable businesses of all sizes—from startups and SMEs to large enterprises—to accept payments, manage transactions, fund operations, and accelerate growth.

PayMongo began as a payment gateway offering simple, developer-friendly APIs for online payments. Since then, it has evolved into a comprehensive platform that supports both online and offline commerce, helping entrepreneurs and enterprises alike streamline their financial operations. Its product offerings include online payments via cards, e-wallets, and over-the-counter channels, QR Ph-powered in-store payments, capital lending solutions, and real-time transaction management.

The company is a licensed Electronic Money Issuer (EMI) regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas and operates through its subsidiary, PayMongo Payments, Inc. It partners with major platforms like Lazada and has enabled tens of thousands of Filipino businesses to thrive in a rapidly digitizing market.
